scope: Separate CAL-only pre-LLM cascade extension; base candidates and standalone operating points unchanged
accepted_checks: native_core BLOCK produces hard BLOCK; any non-ALLOW core state produces STOP_UNKNOWN; only core ALLOW reaches the soft confidence stage.
Soft raw UNKNOWN/invalid/low-confidence produces DEFER_LLM. DEFER is neither business STOP nor correct decisive resolution.
Any prior DEFER disqualifies whole-episode autonomy. Potential downstream opportunities remain separately labeled and do not assume LLM correctness.

Episode decisions respect event_seq and first hard BLOCK/STOP_UNKNOWN. Known wrong automatic decisions invalidate autonomy. Source UNKNOWN/mixed episodes cannot certify autonomy; known unsafe ALLOW is counted even in mixed episodes.
Objective gives each base group equal total mass with equal weight among its episodes. Repetitions cannot gain objective weight.
Constraints use zero observed unsafe automatic ALLOW and at most 5 percent stops among fully source-ALLOW episodes, including mandatory UNKNOWN stops. DEFER does not count as FPR.

Fixed grid exhaustively varies ALLOW and BLOCK thresholds by checkpoint with equivalent-output deduplication; all-defer is an explicit soft-stage control. No estimator fitting or LLM answers enter the module.
Only six source-head models appear in the released cascade calibration, each with p4 and joint operating points. Native diagnostic heads are excluded.
Configuration and operating points are frozen separately from the original 24 standalone operating points; original model manifest and weights match their referenced hashes.

verification.checks: Threshold membership in fixed grid, eligible checkpoint keys, feasibility, source annotation row totals, episode category totals, false-stop denominator arithmetic, group-weighted coverage arithmetic, objective not below explicit control.

limits: Metrics inspected are CAL calibration metrics only, not selected-set quality. Their calculation was source-audited and consistency-checked, not independently recomputed from underlying CAL rows.

Freeze hashes establish current identity; root retains chronology evidence for protocol amendment after a usage-only pilot and before selected decision/gold disclosure. Reviewer did not inspect pilot answers.

Cascade feasibility does not reverse or relabel the earlier standalone INFEASIBLE operating points. A full cascade quality/cost claim requires actual routed downstream decisions and separate evaluation.
